topic: Campaign report data discrepancy on production
summary_markdown: A user reported an issue with campaign reports, noting that the endpoint `/api/campaigns/report/charts` returns no data for 'Chart1' on production, even though the data exists locally (using the prod database). [me] confirmed this was a known error previously discussed in development and stated it was fixed yesterday in develop but did not seem to have deployed to production.
decisions: The campaign report endpoint needs deployment verification from develop to production.
action_items: Verify deployment of the fix for the campaign report endpoint to production.
